native.pwm_profile: Actual reviewed API/peripheral edition or separately registered device profile.
native.pwm_phase: Actual operation versus explicitly requested platform-argument initialization proposal.
native.pwm_polarity: Normal activeHIGH/inversed activeLOW in the Linux state API; separate STM OC mode.
native.pwm_readback: Requested software state is not implemented hardware state or an observed waveform.
native.pwm_disabled_level: Actual disabled output may remain active/inactive/high impedance/toggling; never assume LOW.
native.pwm_clock_source: Selected conventional STM TIM clock, not a universal PWM frequency default.
native.pwm_count_mode: Actual edge up/down or full up/down center triangle, not update-event frequency.
native.pwm_oc_mode: Actual STM output-reference comparator mode, independent of physical pin polarity.
native.pwm_pin_polarity: Actual physical output inversion after STM OC reference.
native.pwm_dt_translation: Actual source-qualified Linux standard DT translator or device-specific binding.
native.pwm_outcome: Actual functional consumer acceptance, not valid driver configuration.
native.pwm_device_source: Actual chip/timer firmware/driver/API version and supported period/duty/atomic/capture capabilities.
native.pwm_clock_source_evidence: Actual timer clock routing, stability, prescaling and achievable resolution.
native.pwm_wiring_source: Actual assigned output/input pin, driver electrical levels, reference ground and load.
native.pwm_mapping_source: Actual consumer duty/pulse/value mapping, polarity and permitted operating range.
native.pwm_waveform_source: Actual correlated implemented/readback/captured waveform and rounding evidence.
native.pwm_acceptance_source: Actual consumer action, sample age, application update and fault/safe-state requirements.
native.pwm_registered_source: Actual separately registered alternate peripheral/mode/codec limits and semantics.
native.pwm_chip_id: Actual Linux chip/peripheral identity, not CAN ECU or inferred bus master.
native.pwm_pin_id: Actual electrically connected PWM pin, not an invented signal address.
native.pwm_safe_state_source: Actual plant/device required fault-state electrical behavior and observation, not disabled=>safe.
native.pwm_period_ns: Actual requested state period or waveform period; state0 allowed only disabled, waveform0 disables.
native.pwm_duty_ns: Actual active duration; Linux inverse polarity active means LOW, not always physical HIGH.
native.pwm_offset_ns: Actual waveform offset;0 permitted, positive must be strictly less than waveform period.
native.pwm_inactive_ns: Actual non-active duration in the physically meaningful enabled waveform.
native.pwm_high_ns: Actual physical HIGH duration; polarity affects relation with active duration.
native.pwm_low_ns: Actual physical LOW duration, not always period-minus-HIGH inferred for disabled output.
native.pwm_implemented_period_ns: Actual hardware-returned integer-ns period; requested state alone does not prove this.
native.pwm_implemented_duty_ns: Actual hardware-returned active duration; fractional sub-ns quantization may remain.
native.pwm_implemented_offset_ns: Actual returned waveform offset, not invented phase0.
native.pwm_args_period_ns: Actual board/firmware reference argument, not hardware state or a generic servo20ms.
native.pwm_dt_flags: Actual standard DT polarity bit; device-specific translators need their own binding source.
native.pwm_channel: Actual perchip channel index0..npwm-1; exclusive consumer ownership required.
native.pwm_channels: Actual hardware npwm count, not inferred4channels for every timer.
native.pwm_counter_bits: Actual selected conventional STM TIM counter width16 or32, not all PWM hardware.
native.pwm_psc: Actual conventional STM 16bit prescaler register; division is PSC+1.
native.pwm_arr: Actual selected timer auto-reload register; device width bounds apply.
native.pwm_ccr: Actual compare register; CCR greater than ARR can represent constant level, not invalid by itself.
native.pwm_rcr: Actual supported repetition counter; updates differ from physical PWM periods.
native.pwm_rcr_bits: Actual selected timer repetition-register width, not a universal16bit capability.
native.pwm_period_ticks: Actual full edge ARR+1 or center2*ARR counter ticks; repetition does not extend PWM period.
native.pwm_psc_divider: Actual derived PSC+1 divider, including valid PSC0=>divide1.
native.pwm_repetition_divider: Actual derived RCR+1 update divider, not full waveform frequency divisor.
native.pwm_capture_period_ns: Actual Linux capture UInt32 nanosecond period, not generic waveform UInt64.
native.pwm_capture_duty_ns: Actual Linux capture active duration, measured separately from requested output.
native.pwm_capture_timeout_ms: Actual capture-call timeout in milliseconds, not waveform nanoseconds.
native.pwm_frequency_hz: Actual full PWM cycle rate; does not encode bit/s or a framed payload.
native.pwm_duty_percent: Actual active fraction0..100%, not necessarily physical HIGH percentage.
native.pwm_timer_clock_hz: Actual clock reaching the STM prescaler, after external routing/dividers where selected.
native.pwm_counter_clock_hz: Actual counter clock after PSC+1; device PLL/RCC default not invented.
native.pwm_update_event_hz: Actual overflow/underflow UEV cadence including RCR; distinct full PWM cycle.
native.pwm_capture_counter_hz: Actual counter frequency used by STM paired PWM-input capture.
native.pwm_capture_ccr_period: Actual reset-on-edge period capture register, not a software nanosecond value.
native.pwm_captured_frequency_hz: Actual PWM-input measured frequency from counterclock/periodcapture.
native.pwm_captured_duty_percent: Actual measured active percentage from paired capture counts.
native.pwm_voltage_high_v: Actual electrical HIGH at loaded output, not a generic3.3V proposal.
native.pwm_voltage_low_v: Actual electrical LOW at loaded output, not automatically0V.
native.pwm_receiver_vih_v: Actual receiver guaranteed HIGH recognition lower limit.
native.pwm_receiver_vil_v: Actual receiver guaranteed LOW recognition upper limit.
native.pwm_update_bound_ms: Actual command-to-applied waveform/consumer bound, not a bus queue.
native.pwm_freshness_ms: Actual application freshness requirement, no universal500ms.
native.pwm_deadtime_ns: Actual device-qualified complementary-output deadtime, not all timers support it.
native.pwm_resolution_ns: Actual achieved timer/output timing quantum, not requested integer-ns precision.
native.pwm_jitter_bound_ns: Actual verified edge jitter bound, not default0.
native.pwm_enabled: Actual requested Linux PWM state enable, not proof of electrical output.
native.pwm_usage_power: Actual permission for driver phase optimization preserving power; cannot imply scheduled edges.
native.pwm_atomic_context: Actual Linux apply from non-sleeping context requiring atomic-capable chip.
native.pwm_chip_atomic: Actual selected driver/chip atomic apply capability, not enabled by default.
native.pwm_exclusive_owner: Actual channel allocation belongs to the intended consumer.
native.pwm_exact_integer_ns: Actual Linux waveform exact integer-ns request; not proof of zero fractional physical error.
native.pwm_waveform_verified: Actual independent implementation/readback/capture evidence is valid.
native.pwm_mapping_valid: Actual consumer mapping and polarity checked.
native.pwm_electrical_valid: Actual wiring/load/levels/ground checked against both endpoint specifications.
native.pwm_signal_accepted: Actual new functional PWM signal accepted by mapped consumer.
native.pwm_safe_state_verified: Actual requested fault/safe state observed, not inferred from disable.
native.pwm_preload: Actual STM ARR/CCR preload used; next UEV must latch settings.
native.pwm_update_latched: Actual expected STM UEV latched preloaded output settings.
native.pwm_complementary: Actual paired complementary outputs; deadtime/wiring/fault requirements separate.
native.pwm_break_enabled: Actual selected STM break input protection configuration.
native.pwm_break_active: Actual break event may force predefined OIS state; normal waveform not implied.
native.payload_bytes: Applicationcodec metadata only; directPWM defines no1byteframe/bitrate/CRC/packetqueue. Actualperiod/duty/polarity/value mapping requiresdevice/peripheral/consumer sources.
